integrity: Exact graph definitions, component-case proof, orbit table and executable independent checks are included; no inference from finite experiments to all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Two-subset Kneser graphs only; no larger block sizes or nonminimum sets. The Petersen 125-case is a complete finite classification; the \(n\ge6\) result has a structural all-parameter proof. Priority and outside expert verification are not claimed.
title: Minimum paired domination in two-subset Kneser graphs
